text: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，进一步增强资本市场内在稳定性。总结过去几年经验做法，持续加强稳市场机制建设，不断壮大市场稳定力量。进一步拓宽中长期资金来源、渠道和入市方式，健全“长钱长投”的市场机制和生态。强化风险监测预警和综合研判应对，全力维护资本市场平稳运行。
text_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said the CSRC will further enhance the intrinsic stability of the capital market. Summarizing the experience and practices of the past few years, it will continue to strengthen the building of market stabilization mechanisms and steadily expand the forces for market stability. It will further broaden the sources, channels, and entry methods of medium- and long-term funds, and improve the market mechanism and ecosystem for "long-term money going into long-term investment." It will strengthen risk monitoring, early warning, and comprehensive analysis and response, and make every effort to maintain the smooth operation of the capital market.
